blockers.detail: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN missing; cannot list backups or call Management API.
Restore to a New Project is dashboard-only and requires authenticated Supabase session; browser landed on sign-in.
POST /database/backups/restore-pitr restores the live project and was intentionally not used.
Supabase branches are data-less (with_data=false); existing preview branch julpgmotykvwtnyqhxvf is not a PITR data restore.

how_to_unblock: Create a Personal Access Token at https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens
Store it only in gitignored .secrets/supabase.env as SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=... (do not paste into chat)
Confirm physical backups / PITR on project wsnpwyqypgclsclktoyf (Database → Backups)
In Dashboard: Database → Backups → Restore to a New Project → choose PITR timestamp (e.g. T-15m UTC)
Reply with the new temporary project ref only (no secrets)
Agent will then verify tables/RLS/RPCs/indexes/audit/DLQ and run non-prod app smoke against that ref only
classification_impact: PITR restore drill remains an open production-readiness blocker
